description.value: Foody World is a large-format Chinese supermarket spanning roughly 60,000 sq ft with ten departments and over 40,000 product varieties, offering a comprehensive one-stop grocery experience. Originally founded in 2001 and headquartered in Toronto, this Richmond BC location operates under its own website and serves the broader Metro Vancouver area. Touring cyclists will find an unusually wide selection of Asian and mainstream groceries at a single stop open every day of the year.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (6 spaces) at 70m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at foodyworldrichmond.ca fully confirms OSM contact details (phone, address, website) and clearly shows an active, operating supermarket open 365 days a year. The About Us page describes a large-format Chinese supermarket (~60,000 sq ft, 10 departments, 40,000+ products), confirming it as a comprehensive grocery destination. No website or OSM content mentions bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null except Basic groceries which is unambiguously confirmed by the supermarket description.
concerns: About Us page describes the brand primarily in terms of its Toronto/GTA origins and 8 GTA-area stores; the Richmond BC location appears to be a separate regional operation (email: Foodyworldbc@gmail.com) rather than a direct GTA-chain branch. No impact on listing validity.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, large supermarket confirmed by an active website — a clear and useful grocery resupply stop for touring cyclists in Richmond.

wow_evidence: large-format Chinese supermarket spanning roughly 60,000 sq ft with ten departments and over 40,000 product varieties … open every day of the year
